viz.description: Pangolin live trajectory/map viewer (SLAM_BUILD_VIZ). Requires OpenGL/X11 dev libraries on Linux, e.g. libgl1-mesa-dev + X11 headers -- not installed by default, opt in with --x-feature=viz.

cuda.description: CUDA-accelerated optical flow via OpenCV's cudaoptflow module (SLAM_USE_CUDA_OPTFLOW). Requires the NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit installed locally -- vcpkg does not install it. Windows x64 native builds only; use the with-cuda preset.
